name: Autobacs Seven Co., Ltd.
summary: Autobacs Seven Co., Ltd., together with its subsidiaries, operates a chain of retail stores for automotive goods and services in Japan and internationally. It operates through four segments: AUTOBACS Business; Consumer Business; Wholesale Business; and Expansion Business. The AUTOBACS Business segment engages in the wholesale of car accessories, such as tires, wheels, and car electronics to franchisees. The Consumer Business segment sells car accessories through physical stores, websites, and official apps, as well as offers installation, vehicle maintenance, and vehicle inspections services, and bodywork services; and purchases and sells vehicles.
